issue_context.title: Atlas auto re-importing
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please search existing issues for potential duplicates before filing yours:	
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues?q=is%3Aissue	
-->

**Godot version:**
v3.2.2.stable.official


**OS/device including version:**
Windows 10


**Issue description:**
Does texture atlas update by detecting changing one of consist sprites? Expected behiavour like working with individual sprites.


**Steps to reproduce:**
1. unzip attached example.
2. open project.
3. open textures folder from project
4. open one of sprites (a.png, b.png,c.png.) with any image editor and redraw.
5. goto godot editor.
6. atlas doesn't updated.

_but you can manually update atlas by:_
a) close godot editor and reopen project.
or
b) choose atlas and hit re-import in "import" tab.

**Minimal reproduction project:**
here -> [example.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/4862786/example.zip)
